crossRefs.note: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.
I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.

translations.web: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”
translations.bsb: The king’s servants replied, “Whatever our lord the king decides, we are your servants.”
translations.kjv: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.
translations.asv: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall choose.
